author: Sevoo
body:
Skype: SevoMC
Age: Rather say on Skype. Thanks.
Time Zone: EST
Previous teams/tournament experience: Bxtches, Emancipators, Kaldorei, etc. Just teams that weren't really competitive, just for teams. I want competitive now
Preferred Position: Anything but defense. I prefer rusher and midfield.

Kills: 39 551
Deaths: 29 115
K/D: 1.36
PvP K/D: 1.57

I would just like to say don't be fooled by my deaths. I used to get around 4 fps so being killed was easy. I get 500 fps now, so I get around 5 kills per death now (average).

I also used to fall into the void a lot, explaining my 1.36  KD and 1.57 PvP KD.
